purpose: Design, implement and verify data-quality controls, expectations, profiling, anomaly/lineage checks, quarantine and repair evidence while preserving domain meaning, data-engineering ownership, privacy/security and statistical interpretation boundaries.

owns: Data-quality rules/expectations, profiling, validation, anomaly detection, quality incidents, quarantine and quality-state evidence across declared datasets/contracts.
does_not_own: Business/domain semantics, source-system truth, data-pipeline architecture ownership, privacy/legal acceptance, or statistical/model interpretation by default.
escalates_when: A quality rule requires domain meaning that is ambiguous or disputed.
Repair would mutate source or downstream state beyond the package's bounded authority.

minimum_capabilities: Preserve exact candidate/environment identity and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Stop or hand off when a decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute equivalent procedures using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Accepted project/system state relevant to the profession.
Exact candidate, interfaces, dependencies and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded implementation/design/evidence packets with exact scope and non-claims.
Explicit handoffs when another profession owns a decision.
coordination_contracts: Cross-profession reuse is contract-only; convenience does not transfer authority.
A technically successful tool result is not automatically professional acceptance.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Data-quality contracts, lineage-aware validation and quarantine.
Quality incidents, anomaly triage, repair verification and known-quality state.

references.scope: Data Warehousing Specialist occupational baseline for data quality, ETL and warehouse operations; not profession identity.
Software QA occupational baseline for validation and defect evidence; not profession identity.
AXM evidence labels and truth boundaries.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, device, dataset or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

skills.description: Define testable data-quality expectations tied to exact data meaning and lineage.
evidence_required: Rule, dataset/version, field semantics and threshold rationale are explicit.

skills.description: Separate source defects, pipeline defects, domain changes and measurement artifacts.
evidence_required: Observed anomaly and lineage evidence are preserved.

tools.purpose: Profile and validate declared datasets/contracts with lineage-aware evidence.
allowed_actions: Run bounded checks, capture failing rows/statistics and quarantine candidates.
forbidden_actions: Invent domain meaning or silently delete/repair source data.
tools.failure_boundary: Ambiguous semantic validity is handed to the domain owner.

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation or analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary or failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Quality claims name exact dataset/version/lineage, rule, threshold and observed failures.
Schema-valid or complete data is not automatically semantically correct, unbiased, private, statistically valid or fit for every use.
minimum_for_working: Representative success, failure and abstention fixtures pass in materially different contexts.
At least one external human-work baseline and one real project/practice evidence set challenge the body.
Cross-intelligence portability and boundary behavior are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_consult: Domain owner for semantic validity and threshold meaning.
Data Engineer/Data Platform for pipeline/source repair.
Privacy/Security/Statistician/Data Scientist for their respective acceptance surfaces.
must_not_decide: Declare data correct solely because structural checks pass.
Silently repair or drop records without owner/provenance.

handoffs.to: Domain / Data Engineering / Privacy / Security / Statistics
handoffs.when: Quality issue requires semantic, pipeline, legal/security or inferential decision beyond validation ownership.

failure_library.symptom: Dataset passes schema/null checks but values are semantically impossible.
likely_causes: Structural and semantic quality were collapsed.
checks: Consult domain constraints and source lineage.
repair_path: Add bounded semantic rule or hand to domain owner.

professional_tests.fixture: Dataset is schema-valid and complete but category values changed meaning upstream.
expected_observations: Detects semantic uncertainty/lineage change and refuses blanket quality pass.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Structural pass does not become semantic correctness.

professional_tests.fixture: A failed record can be made green by deleting it.
expected_observations: Preserves failure/quarantine provenance and requires owner-approved repair semantics.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
